page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: one column of running text, with a marginal number "23" at the left beside a paragraph; the right-hand edge of the left page is cut by the gutter. Right page (partial, at the far right edge): fragments of a second column of text, mostly cut off by the gutter and not legible as full lines; no full text block transcribed beyond the edge fragments.

main_text.l: boves & septem spicas, esse septem annos:
& semen esse verbum Dei: hic tropus, quia
ceffario in his verbis ponitur, redundat
necessario verbum includit, ut notum est
23 Inde secundo loco fuse admodum laborans
populum novum Testamentum. Et is quidem
dicimus Testamenti sanguinem, quia eo bona
dicitur Hoc esse novum Testamentum in sanguine
Christi, quando sanguis Christi in passione
novum Testamentum seu foedus inter Deum
temporaria fuisse confectum. Ita in poculo
coenae recte dici: Hoc est novum
